about: Anti-slop rules for gate.py. Each rule: id, pattern (Python regex), applies (prose | code | css | markup | message | all), severity (error blocks, warn reports), hint (how to fix it). unless_brief skips the rule when the brief matches that regex, so a brief that asks for a gradient can have one. Patterns are case-insensitive unless case_sensitive is true.

rules.hint: Say what was done: read, checked, traced, measured.
Name the actual parts and how they connect.
State the evidence itself, not that something proves something.
Say what breaks without it, or cut the word.
Name the specific market, field, or set of tools.

rules.pattern: \b(?:seamless(?:ly)?|elevate[sd]?|unleash(?:es|ed)?|embark(?:s|ed)? on|cutting[- ]edge|next[- ]level|supercharge[sd]?|revolutioni[sz]e[sd]?|empower(?:s|ed|ing)?|harness(?:es|ed)? the power|unlock(?:s|ed)? the (?:full )?potential|in today's (?:fast-paced|digital|modern) world|ever[- ]evolving|navigat(?:e|ing) the complexit(?:y|ies)|a myriad of|plethora)\b
rules.hint: Replace the stock phrase with the concrete thing it stands for.

rules.pattern: \b(?:it'?s (?:worth|important to) not(?:e|ing) that|it is worth noting|at the end of the day|when it comes to)\b
rules.hint: Cut the throat-clearing and state the point.

rules.pattern: \A\W*(?:great question|what a (?:great|fantastic|wonderful|excellent)|certainly!|absolutely!|of course!|sure thing|i'?d be (?:happy|delighted|glad) to|i hope this (?:helps|finds you))
rules.hint: Open with the result.

rules.pattern: (?:i hope (?:this|that) helps|let me know if you (?:have any|need any|want any)|feel free to (?:reach out|ask))\W*\Z
rules.hint: End on the last useful fact.
Drop the 'not just X, it's Y' frame; say Y and why.
Say what it is.
Write for one reader with one goal.
Show the thing instead of asking the reader to imagine it.
Invent a specific name that fits the brief's world.
Give the person or character a real name and a role.
Write the real copy; it is part of the design.
Give the page the product's name.

rules.pattern: \b(?:your (?:tagline|headline|text|content) here|insert (?:text|content|image) here|sample text|placeholder text|click here to learn more)\b
rules.hint: Write the copy that belongs there.
Finish the code or remove the stub.
Pick colors from the brief's world; the purple-blue gradient is the default every generator reaches for.
Pick colors from the brief's world; indigo-to-purple is the stock gradient.
Choose a typeface with character for the brief, or say why the default fits.
Headings carry words, not decoration.

cadence.about: Prose rhythm checks, applied to paragraph text only (not code, lists, tables, or headings).
